{{Quote|The Captain's concubine betrayed him, stabbing him with his own dagger. But the Captain had the last laugh.|SM-33|<ref name="SC5" />}}
An individual was the '''concubine''' of the [[pirate]] [[Captain]] [[Tak Rennod]]. At one point, when Rennod's [[starship]], the ''[[Onyx Cinder]]'', was heading to the [[planet]] [[At Attin]] to find treasure, Rennod began to suspect his [[Tak Rennod's pirates|crew]] would mutiny. After Rennod's [[Tak Rennod's first mate|first mate]] went mad with greed and challenged him, Rennod was betrayed by his [[concubine]], who stabbed him with his own [[dagger]]. However, Rennod locked the ship's controls, and it crashed into At Attin, [[Death|killing]] the entire crew, including the concubine.<ref name="SC5" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[droid]] [[SM-33]], who had served Rennod, told the ''Onyx Cinder''{{'s}} new [[Skeleton Crew|crew]] about the mutiny against Rennod, including about the concubine's betrayal. The [[Youngling|child]] [[Neel]] then asked what a concubine was, but the pirate [[Jod Na Nawood]] did not answer and instead said that there had been enough story time.<ref name="SC5" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tak Rennod's concubine was mentioned in "[[You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates]],"<ref name="SC5" /> the fifth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="Guide">{{SW|url=series/skeleton-crew/season-1-episode-5-episode-guide|text="You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates" Episode Guide | Star Wars: Skeleton Crew}}</ref> which aired on [[December 24]], [[2024]].<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1861409832349172011|''[[Star Wars]]''|date=2024-11-26|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/uxgSx|archivefile=File:StarWars-SkeletonCrewSchedule-Twitter.png}}</ref>
